purpose: Documented Brawl Helper recommendation scoring rules. These are product heuristics, not official Supercell recommendations.
principles: Never infer ownership from an absent profile component.
Prefer validated mode/map data over global data when available.
Prefer community build usage only when the source has a usable sample.
Always explain the reason behind an actionable recommendation.

metaScore.notes: The normalized meta score is a Brawl Helper derived signal. It must never be presented as an official ranking.

power.description: Progress toward Power 11 for an owned Brawler.

buy.description: Only when the user explicitly confirms the component is not owned.

equip.description: Only when the user explicitly confirms the component is owned but it is not equipped.

check.description: Used when ownership is unknown and the app needs confirmation.

unlock.description: Catalog-only action for Brawlers not present on the account.

confidence.high: Validated source coverage and sufficient sample/observation quality.
confidence.medium: Usable source data with some uncertainty or incomplete coverage.
confidence.low: Sparse, stale, or weakly supported data. Do not use it as the sole reason for a strong recommendation.
